items.name: oxymetazoline nasal spray, 0.5 oz
items.note: Medicated nasal sprays are OTC medicines, eligible without a prescription after 2019.

items.name: soft toothbrush, 2 pack
items.note: Pub 502 names toothbrush and toothpaste as nondeductible personal expenses.

items.name: upper arm blood pressure monitor
items.note: Devices used in diagnosing and treating illness are includible.

items.name: double electric breast pump
items.note: Breast pumps and supplies that assist lactation are includible.

items.name: paper towels, 6 rolls
items.note: Household items ordinarily used for family purposes aren't medical care.

items.name: dual channel TENS unit
items.note: Not named in the sources; a TENS unit is equipment for treating pain but also sold for general muscle relaxation. Eligible only for a condition.

items.name: diclofenac pain relief gel, 100 g
items.note: Medicated topical pain relievers are OTC medicines, eligible after 2019.

items.name: IPA beer, 6 pack
items.note: Tobacco and alcohol are personal purchases with no medical purpose.

items.name: hemorrhoid ointment, 1 oz
items.note: Hemorrhoid treatments are OTC medicines, eligible after 2019.

items.name: electric heating pad, XL
items.note: Sources don't name them; heat and cold packs are equipment for treating an injury but also have ordinary uses. Eligible only when used to treat a condition.

items.name: nicotine gum 4 mg, 100 count
items.note: Pub 502 excludes non-prescribed stop-smoking drugs from the deduction, but for HSA/FSA reimbursement they are OTC medicines, eligible after 2019.

items.name: first aid kit, 100 pieces
items.note: A first aid kit is a set of medical supplies such as bandages.
